# package errors

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/errors"
```

Package errors provides sentinel errors and helpers for the OPC-UA library.

#### Sentinel errors {#hdr-Sentinel_errors}

Use the named sentinel errors in sentinel.go (e.g. ErrNotConnected, ErrSessionClosed) so that callers can use [errors.Is](https://pkg.go.dev/errors#Is) and [errors.As](https://pkg.go.dev/errors#As):

	import opcuaerrors "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/errors"
	if errors.Is(err, opcuaerrors.ErrNotConnected) { ... }

When wrapping errors, use %w so that [errors.Is](https://pkg.go.dev/errors#Is) and [errors.Unwrap](https://pkg.go.dev/errors#Unwrap) work:

	return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect: %w", opcuaerrors.ErrInvalidEndpoint)

```go

	ErrInvalidEndpoint    = errors.New("opcua: invalid endpoint")
	ErrNoCertificate      = errors.New("opcua: no certificate")
	ErrInvalidPrivateKey  = errors.New("opcua: invalid private key")
	ErrInvalidCertificate = errors.New("opcua: invalid certificate")
	ErrNoMatchingEndpoint = errors.New("opcua: no matching endpoint")
	ErrNoEndpoints        = errors.New("opcua: no endpoints available")
	// ErrInsecureNotAllowed is returned for a client configured without
	// message security and without the InsecureNoSecurity option.
	ErrInsecureNotAllowed = errors.New("opcua: connection without message security needs the InsecureNoSecurity option")
)
```
